requirement.summary: Install the exact reviewed Adapter 1.5.0 module into the existing local AgentGov pipx development environment without downloading or building dependencies. Before replacement, exclusively create verified backups of the installed Adapter 1.4.0 module and the broken exposed agentgov launcher. Replace only the installed governance_mcp.py with the reviewed source and refresh only the exposed launcher from the working inner pipx launcher. Verify hashes, configured-command startup, installed discovery, owner-free native proposal schema, hostile-owner pre-elicitation zero-write behavior, and Adapter-owned Human product owner materialization in disposable repositories. Record sanitized installed-runtime evidence and synchronize affected status and public documentation. Preserve project configuration and all consumer, Git, release, and external boundaries.

items: Replacing files outside the repository is a local runtime mutation and must stay limited to the two exact verified pipx targets.
Overwriting or deleting an existing backup would destroy rollback evidence; the operation must fail closed if either backup target appears.
Copying the wrong launcher could keep the project-configured MCP command broken; installed startup and hash equality must be verified immediately.
A failed post-copy check must restore both byte-identical backups before any further action.
Direct module replacement is local development installation evidence, not a reproducible wheel, published package, stable release, or consumer upgrade.
Native form mediation attributes the Human product owner role but does not cryptographically authenticate the individual operator.
Pre-existing uncommitted repository evidence changes and the human-owned project configuration must remain untouched and unstaged.
